title: Moon
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

A moon template containing mesh-specific data only. Orbital parameters are defined in the world definition per entity instance.

collision_shape.description: Collision shape for the moon. Defines how it interacts with other objects.

type.description: Collision shape type. 'sphere' or 'box' are supported.

radius.description: Radius of the sphere in metres (for sphere shape type).

half_extents.description: Half-extents of the box (for box shape type).

offset.description: Offset of the box center from the mesh center (for box shape type).

bounding_box.description: Axis-aligned bounding box of the mesh in moon-local coordinates (metres). Computed once from glTF mesh. Used for debug axes and spatial calculations. Min and max are opposite corners of the box.

min.description: Minimum corner (x, y, z in metres).

max.description: Maximum corner (x, y, z in metres).

is_gravity_source.description: If true, this body generates gravity on other entities. Moons are always gravity sources. Default: true.

animations_enabled.description: If true, mesh animations (e.g., moving clouds) will be played. Default: true.
